detail.title: Intex Vibe Wire C-Type In-Ear Earphones
detail.overview: Experience uninterrupted music with the Intex Vibe Wire C-Type In-Ear Earphones, designed for superior comfort and powerful sound. Equipped with a 10mm dynamic driver, these earphones deliver immersive audio with deep bass and clear vocals. The soft silicon eartips ensure a snug in-ear fit, while the highly flexible cable adds durability for everyday use. With a highly responsive mic and multifunctional control buttons, you can manage calls, volume, and media with ease. Just plug into your Type-C port and enjoy seamless audio—anytime, anywhere.
features: 10mm Dynamic Driver for powerful audio output
Comfy In-ear Design for long listening comfort
Soft Silicon Eartips for a secure and gentle fit
Highly Responsive Microphone for clear calls
Immersive Audio with enhanced sound clarity
Multifunctional Control Buttons (Volume + / Volume - / Call Control)
